points.description: States that a TRNG generates random numbers from an unpredictable physical source/process, so results are truly random and unpredictable (not reproducible).
points.partial_credit: Half if only says TRNG is 'truly random' or physical without clear contrast.

points.description: States that a PRNG uses a mathematical algorithm/formula (computer-based, deterministic) to generate a sequence of numbers, which can be reproduced.
points.partial_credit: Half if only says PRNG is computer/algorithm based without more.

rubric.notes: Full marks for stating, in any wording, that TRNG relies on physical unpredictable sources and PRNG relies on mathematical algorithms/formulas. Give part marks if the answer is vague, e.g. only one side explained well or the contrast is weak. Give zero for wrong or unrelated answers; extra remarks do not cost marks unless they swap the two types.
